newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BAND MOVE AN ADJUSTMENT TO NEIGHBOURS - BI GOVERNOR.
newsitem.headline: BAND MOVE AN ADJUSTMENT TO NEIGHBOURS - BI GOVERNOR.

text.p: Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Thursday the abolishment of the central band announcement was only an adjustment to neighbouring countries.
"If we are the only one left with the band, we will fall prey to speculative attacks. That's why we have adjusted to others," Djiwandono told reporters before addressing a seminar on capital markets.
"We are the only with a band in the region. All our neighbours had scrapped their bands. This is no longer an advantage," the governor said.
Bank Indonesia said on Thursday it will no longer announce its daily intervention and conversion bands with immediate effect.
